notes: *held their peace* is taken whole as the rendering of חרשׁ, since the ASV never writes that idiom without the possessive (rules 20, 44); reading *their* as a supplied possessive `added` under rule 18 was the competing analysis.
הִיא is the unrendered resumptive of the tripartite clause and the copula joins the nominal predicate מִצְוָה (rules 20, 22); the possessive's determiner goes to the possessor's article (rule 29).
